assumptions: ESTIMATED: the baseline Studio has no language or DDD surface, so 'current' is the best available workaround in an editor and shell (the way this repository keeps its language today: prose in docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md). It is not like-for-like: the workaround gives no kernel ripple, no status and no UNKNOWN.

KLM profile: K 0.20 s (average skilled typist), P 1.10 s, B 0.10 s per press or per release, H 0.40 s, M 1.35 s (K, P, H, M and the 21 percent from Card, Moran and Newell 1980; B from a tertiary summary, and two B equal the 1980 paper's one K per button press; H is not inserted in these flows, see ADR-0062 for the H variant), band plus or minus 21 percent (an RMS error, not a confidence interval); expert, error-free, routine use only. A click is two B ops (press, release); a drag is press, P, release, so it carries two B ops as well. M is used for both preparation and a short read; reading many items is NOT modelled, which favours the workaround with long output.

Layout stems: 'proposed-language' is design/layouts/proposed-language.json (layout lane). Its sample tree differs from this aspect's sample tree, so a tree-item-* id there is a geometry stand-in for the row named in the note. Stems 'language-tree-suspect' and 'language-tree-ai' are defined inline in docs/hci/design/language-and-ddd-tree.md Appendix B (states that no design/layouts file has yet); the integrator should extract them into design/layouts/. '__pointer' is the layout lane's virtual pointer rest position. P ops without a layout stem are steps in an editor or chat window outside the Studio: no layout exists for them, so they use the KLM constant.
Task ids: brief id plus a variant suffix (T05-rename, T05-move-drag, T05-move-menu, T05-add), following the IA lane's T02-kbd; the shared format shows plain T-ids.
New name 13 characters; old name 20 characters typed only in the current flow.

Proposed: term row visible or reached by an earlier step; the mouse-to-keyboard H is omitted in both flows. Sensitivity with H 0.40 s at every device switch (ADR-0062, Quantitative model): current 14.20 (0 H), proposed 8.60 (1 H).
Rename of a kernel-bound identifier is refused in v0.2 (ADR-003); this flow is for an unbound language term or a display label, which needs a kernel ADR for a language dimension.
